title: test(rest): fail the late-cancel control loudly when its wait for the results write runs out

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DFm2bnNC5WSDWCqwoXTpNTR)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyGcBtnptfcfKE14ZS

Fixes #27839

## What changes

In `packages/rest/src/import-job-integration.test.ts`, the control "a cancel that lands after the last row still wins over an all-failed outcome" now records how many rows the `results` read returned during its 400 × 5 ms wait, and asserts it reached 3 before it checks the job row. Test-only; no product change.

## Why

The worker's final patch is the only write of `results`. If the wait ran out, the cancel route's own `cancelled` write and the progress flush could satisfy the status and count checks without the final patch ever landing. The new assertion makes an exhausted wait fail on its own cause (contract review of #27795, record 6512470441, should-fix 1).

## Verification

- `npx vitest run src/import-job-integration.test.ts` in `packages/rest`: 21/21 pass.
- Ablation (local, restored): with the wait loop cut to 0 iterations, the new line fails with `expected +0 to be 3`. Under the same ablation the pre-change test also fails, but on the later `toMatchObject` counts, which does not name the wait.
- `packages/rest` full suite: 357 files, 7073 passed, 350 skipped.
